commands.command:
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/renew-https-8443-cert >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_RENEW'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

CERT_DIR=/etc/https-8443
CERT="$CERT_DIR/tls.crt"
KEY="$CERT_DIR/tls.key"
RENEW_BEFORE=604800

umask 077
mkdir -p "$CERT_DIR"
exec 9>/run/https-8443-renew.lock
flock -n 9 || exit 0

if [ "${1:-}" != "--force" ] && [ -s "$CERT" ] && [ -s "$KEY" ] && openssl x509 -checkend "$RENEW_BEFORE" -noout -in "$CERT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    logger -t https-8443-renew "certificate is still outside renewal window"
    exit 0
fi

TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d "$CERT_DIR/.renew.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
HOST_FQDN=$(hostname -f 2>/dev/null || hostname)
HOST_SHORT=$(hostname)
HOST_IP=$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')

{
    printf '%s\n' '[req]' 'distinguished_name=dn' 'x509_extensions=v3_req' 'prompt=no'
    printf '%s\n' '[dn]' "CN=$HOST_FQDN"
    printf '%s\n' '[v3_req]' "subjectAltName=DNS:$HOST_FQDN,DNS:$HOST_SHORT,IP:$HOST_IP"
    printf '%s\n' 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:FALSE'
    printf '%s\n' 'keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment'
    printf '%s\n' 'extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth'
} > "$TMP_DIR/openssl.cnf"

openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -nodes -days 30 \
    -config "$TMP_DIR/openssl.cnf" \
    -keyout "$TMP_DIR/tls.key" -out "$TMP_DIR/tls.crt" >/dev/null 2>&1
chmod 0600 "$TMP_DIR/tls.key"
chmod 0644 "$TMP_DIR/tls.crt"
mv "$TMP_DIR/tls.key" "$KEY"
mv "$TMP_DIR/tls.crt" "$CERT"

if systemctl is-active --quiet nginx; then
    nginx -t
    systemctl reload nginx
fi

SERIAL=$(openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -serial | sed 's/^serial=//')
logger -t https-8443-renew "installed certificate serial $SERIAL"
ANTRIEB_RENEW
sudo chown root:root /usr/local/sbin/renew-https-8443-cert
sudo chmod 0750 /usr/local/sbin/renew-https-8443-cert
sudo /usr/local/sbin/renew-https-8443-cert --force
sudo openssl x509 -in /etc/https-8443/tls.crt -noout -subject -serial -dates
